Decision 2026-09-26: keep the SaaS gap analysis federal and contractual. Customers require SOC 2, and the FTC enforces reasonable data security under Section 5 against companies whose security practices are unfair or whose security promises are deceptive. The CCPA cybersecurity audit regulations (N51 requirements) are kept as a state-specific applicability check only.
